title: Lumen Ledger: Make FinLit Fun
author: Need300dollars
selftext:
Lumen Ledger: Make FinLit Fun
The Fog is rolling in, and the only thing that can push it back is a well-kept ledger.
You're Pip, who has just inherited a run-down island market and a pile of debt. Build stalls, serve the Glimmers who wander in, and get your island to the Lighthouse in 10 seasons.
How it plays
Build your market. Place stalls like the Fruit Stand, Bakery, Lantern Shop, Fish Market and Tea House, hire helpers, and unlock new land.
Fill your jars. Every coin you earn can go into Spend, Save, Invest or Protect. Pay yourself first and the island thrives.
Fight the Debt Fog. Borrowing and overspending thicken it. Repaying and saving push it back.
Spot the scams. Slippery characters offer "once-in-a-season" deals. Read the fine print, because the game shows you the true cost.
Read the Ledger. Each season ends with a review of income, interest and what the Fog took, plus a short FinLit lesson and up to three stars.
Endless mode unlocks after your first win.

  
For the Zoud Gamelab, Global game Jam

comments.author: Upbeat-Strain-7999
comments.body: the FinLit lesson angle is a smart hook. a lot of financial literacy games lean too hard on dry quizzes, so wrapping it into a market sim with an actual fog mechanic sounds way more engaging. curious how deep the investing and scam mechanics go, since that's where most games in this space stay pretty surface level.

replies.body: for sure, I'll give it a try and let you know what I think. the concept has real potential so I'm curious how it feels in practice.
